opening.argument: The speaker presents the platform as a source of dollar-based earnings, stating that participants can engage in dollar marketing and earn in dollars. He reinforces that solicitation with an assurance that the dollar opportunity will never close, portraying the income as continuing rather than uncertain. The presentation also includes a personal referral link for participation, while the demonstrated account separates earnings from "Partners" and "Team" counts. Together, these features indicate a recruitment-linked income structure rather than neutral financial commentary.
